$comment: Canonical cross-platform design tokens — the single source of truth for the palette, control geometry, radii and type scale shared by web (apps/web/src/styles.css), Android (Compose), iOS (SwiftUI), and the desktop app (Rust/gpui). The `palette` colors are authored as OKLCH to mirror the web theme verbatim; scripts/generate.ts converts them to sRGB hex for the native targets so the palette is never hand-transcribed. Run `bun run --filter @exp/design-tokens generate` after editing.

semantic.$comment: Fixed brand accent colors for status/priority/due-date. Not derived from the neutral surface palette; authored as sRGB hex and shared so iOS/Android/desktop stop each carrying their own copy. `brand` is the accent itself (dots, tints, icons, strokes); `brandStrong` is the fill variant every client MUST use for a solid brand surface that carries text — white on `brand` is only 4.28:1, under the WCAG AA 4.5:1 floor, while white on `brandStrong` is 6.02:1.

glass.$comment: Glass surface system (EXP-269), transcribed verbatim from the canonical mobile look (apps/ios/ExpUI/Sources/GlassTheme.swift, ported 1:1 to apps/android/.../ui/theme/Glass.kt). A zinc-950→900 page gradient with white-alpha fills and hairline strokes layered on top. Mobile UI keeps its hand-written GlassTokens — do not migrate it; these exist so web (styles.css --glass-* vars, parity-tested) and desktop (Rust) derive the exact same values.

radius.$comment: Web --radius is 12px; sm/md/lg/xl/xl2/xl3 mirror Tailwind's calc()-derived rounded-sm…3xl steps, which land on the mobile glass ladder (row 10 / section 12 / card 16 / sheet 24). xl2/xl3 because 2xl/3xl are not valid identifiers in the native targets.

size.$comment: Control geometry in px/dp. Web button heights h-9/h-8/h-6 = 36/32/24; input h-9 = 36; list rows h-8 = 32.
